final: WITH r AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS z, s.insurstat AS st, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS mc FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.insurstat) <> '' GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), a AS (SELECT st, AVG(ratio) AS av FROM r GROUP BY st) SELECT r.st AS insurance_status, AVG(r.ratio) AS avg_ratio_above, COUNT(*) AS site_count, AVG(r.ratio - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM r JOIN a ON a.st = r.st WHERE r.ratio > a.av GROUP BY r.st
